component.name: rom-hamster
component.summary: Collect, organize and package retro game ROMs

description.p: rom-hamster keeps a retro game ROM collection in a local SQLite library. It detects platforms from file extensions, imports single ROMs and archives, groups multi-disc games and verifies DAT entries.
It also exports library metadata for EmulationStation, ES-DE and Pegasus.
The application does not launch games or download content by itself.

screenshot.caption: Library list with platform, year and disc count

ul.li: Platform detection for 101 systems with layered rules.
ROM, archive, media and DAT import with cancel and crash resume.
Library search with 13 filters, 4 sort orders and detail pages.
Exports for EmulationStation, ES-DE and Pegasus.
GTK 4 front-end with drag-and-drop import and video preview.
